_comment: Manually pinned high-impact events for the probability engine.
FRED has no usable forward calendar for central-bank decisions: release 101
(FOMC) returns an entry for every single calendar day, which carries no
schedule information at all, and the ECB and Bank of England are not carried
as dated FRED releases. Rather than guess those dates, the engine reports
them as NOT TRACKED and reads anything you pin here.
Add entries from the central banks' own published calendars:
when_utc must be the statement time in UTC. impact is HIGH or medium.
affects lists the asset codes the event moves; omit it to mean all three.
An event inside a horizon widens that horizon's distribution and cuts its
confidence, so a wrong date will visibly distort the output - check them.
